name: @epoch/world-runtime
description: Epoch Interactive World Runtime (W057, ACR-007/X2.0) — the host-side runtime that drives the Renderer Fabric so the spatial world is the PRIMARY Epoch problem-solving workspace. Owns the wall-clock host loop (the fabric core stays virtual-time-only; the runtime is the only wall-clock reader and derives virtual times from it), the ephemeral navigation/camera presentation state, semantic layer derivation, host-originated typed world-interaction intents (the EXISTING @epoch/world-experience vocabulary, never a parallel one), raw viewport-input normalization through the REAL RendererFabric seam (@epoch/renderer-fabric), canonical-projection remounts after every scene revision (the W016 pure store + reducer, never a second semantic store), renderer selection/health/fallback orchestration, and the pure workspace view models any app surface (web feature, desktop host, harnesses) renders. Zero engine imports, zero GPU code, zero UI-framework dependencies.
